final: SELECT m.college, SUM(i.amount) AS income_sum, SUM(i.amount) / (SELECT SUM(group_sum) FROM (SELECT SUM(i2.amount) AS group_sum FROM income AS i2 JOIN member AS m2 ON CAST(m2.member_id AS TEXT) = CAST(i2.link_to_member AS TEXT) JOIN major AS ma2 ON CAST(ma2.major_id AS TEXT) = CAST(m2.link_to_major AS TEXT) GROUP BY ma2.college)) AS income_share FROM income AS i JOIN member AS mem ON CAST(mem.member_id AS TEXT) = CAST(i.link_to_member AS TEXT) JOIN major AS m ON CAST(m.major_id AS TEXT) = CAST(mem.link_to_major AS TEXT) GROUP BY m.college
